title: The industrial revolution in reverse engineering
description: What manual RE and reconstructing TH08, TH095 and TH04 taught me about agents, verification and knowledge that compounds across projects.

title: DX-Ball's sound-pan calculation
description: Recover a sound-pan calculation from a 1996 Windows game. REA's instructions, caller references and numeric constants lead to a small C function, checked against the original behavior and all 63 compiled bytes.

title: How an authenticator generates a login code
description: Find Aegis's six-digit code calculation in its released APK. Trace the generating methods with REA, then move a demo clock to see why the code changes every 30 seconds.

title: How Notion copies text and HTML
description: Trace a page-facing API through Notion's packaged JavaScript. Follow its IPC wrappers to the system clipboard, then see how a small HTML marker keeps rich block data connected to a copy.

title: How TH04 aims a ring of bullets
description: Inspect the original 16-bit angle helper with REA. Match its multiply, divide and coordinate operations to readable C++, then see how they produce a ring aimed at the player.

title: Solve a CTF flag checker
description: Inspect an easy DownUnderCTF challenge with REA. Find its checking functions, turn masks and sums into equations, then verify the solved flag with the original program.
